title: Katseye hits 1B streams on Spotify for 1st time with ‘Gabriela’
summary: Katseye exceeded 1 billion streams on Spotify with “Gabriela” on Friday, marking a first for the group in adding its name to the platform’s “Billions Club,” Hybe X Geffen Records announced Sunday.…

blocks.text: Katseye exceeded 1 billion streams on Spotify with “Gabriela” on Friday, marking a first for the group in adding its name to the platform’s “Billions Club,” Hybe X Geffen Records announced Sunday. “Gabriela” released in June last year ahead of the group’s second EP, “Beautiful Chaos,” entering Billboard’s Hot 100 at No. 21, the highest rung for the six-member act at the time. The pop number tinged with Latin vibes spent 28 weeks on the main songs chart.
